answer: Root identity in a bonded lineage registry. Each new account posts a 500 POA bond and records its funder, key, and inviter. Attestations from kin-linked accounts, sharing a funder or key, count at one tenth weight, so a farm that forks 1,000 clones from one wallet buys 1,000 onyx profiles whose votes echo one funder's voice. Only peers at the summit of the standing curve, with five unrelated established seals, can lift a new account to quorum. Forging one viable voter costs $50 in gas plus five real attestations, which no script manufactures.
